title: Amnesty International: Libyan authorities 'are more and more violent towards migrants'
summary: NGOs are accusing the European Union of being "complicit in horrific violations and abuses in Libya". Amnesty International in particular says the EU is effectively cooperating with what it calls a xenophobic and racist country.
